Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this enthralling series then. India win this series by 2-1 and it will give them a lot of confidence with the World Cup around the corner. India will play another three-match T20I series next up against South Africa. The first game of that series will be played on 28th of September and it will start at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Australia, on the other hand, will play two T20Is against West Indies at home. The first game of that home series for them will be played on the 5th of October, 2022. That game will start at 1.40 pm IST (8.10 am GMT). There is also plenty of other cricketing action to catch up till then. Cheers!

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India says that it is a special place and he says that they have a lot of memories as an India team in Hyderabad and also when he played for Hyderabad in the Indian T20 League. Tells that they wanted to put up a show and they did that.  Feels that the biggest positives were to see different individuals taking up responsibility and that is pleasing to see for the team management. Mentions that the margin of errors are very small and sometimes it comes right and sometimes it does not but he is pretty happy with the performance. Adds that he would like to see their death bowling coming to the party as well but adds that it will take time as Bumrah and Harshal Patel are coming after a long break. He mentions that they do not want to dig deeper into it and hopes that the guys will get better from hereon.

Axar Patel is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES! He says that it is a good feeling to contribute for the team and win the man of the series award. Adds that he tries to bowl in the Powerplay like he does in the Indian T20 League. Mentions that he now understands what the batters are trying to do now and bowl accordingly and is getting the rewards for it.

Suryakumar Yadav is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for this brilliant knock! He talks about his dismissal and says that he was trying to take it on and finish the match there. Tells that his thoughts have been the same all the time and he just tries to execute his plans. Tells that the World Cup will be a challenge but at the same time one should not shy away from expressing oneself but need to be a bit smarter as well.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says that it was a really good series. Adds that the way they held their nerves when Kohli and Suryakumar Yadav were batting that was good to see. Praises Cameron Green for his performance in the series. Mentions that to play three T20Is against a world class side will help the team to gain experience. Tells that there were a lot of positives and they will now prepare for the series at home.
Time for the Presentation...

Virat Kohli is down for a quick chat. He says that he bats at number 3 and has to use his experience while chasing. Adds that the plan was to take Zampa on as he is a crucial bowler for them. Mentions that Suryakumar Yadav is an excellent batter and tells that he got a hundred in England and played well in the Asia Cup as and he continued his form here. Adds that he is striking the ball better than anybody. Tells that when Suryakumar Yadav was attacking Rahul Dravid and Rohit Sharma told him to keep it slow and bat till the end. He says that the game should not have gone till the end but he is happy that they are on the winning side. Adds that he is trying to hit those big ones in the middle overs. Ends by saying that he is happy with the contribution that he is making for the team.

In the first half, Australia started off with a bang with Cameron Green coming out all guns blazing. However, they failed to capitalise in the middle overs with the bat as well as India managed to pick wickets at regular intervals. They still got a par score on the board with Tim David smashing it all around the park in the death overs. For India, Axar Patel was the star yet again with three wickets to his name and Chahal and Harshal Patel were also pretty good which are good signs for India. It was set up to be an exciting chase and that is what we got but looking at the bigger picture with World Cup around the corner, this series will surely go a long way in fine-tuning the squad and plans ahead of the marquee event.

Australia are a great fighting side and that was evident in this game as well. They bowled well in the Powerplay but could not keep a lid on the scoring rate as India managed to keep up with the required rate despite losing two wickets in the Powerplay. Adam Zampa was always going to be the key bowler in the middle phase but he had a bad day in the office and that eventually cost Australia. They did keep themselves in the game though till the end by nailing those wide yorkers brilliantly but it is a game of small margins and India have just managed to inch ahead of them in the end.

We were expecting a high-scoring thriller and that is exactly what we have got here in Hyderabad! India had a tough task on their hand coming into this chase but it was not an impossible task with the pitch being a belter to bat on. India lost KL Rahul early and Rohit Sharma also could not last long as India were in a spot of bother in the Powerplay. However, Virat Kohli and Suryakumar Yadav got together and India kept scoring at a brisk rate through the middle overs with Suryakumar Yadav playing a blinder of a knock. He played some breathtaking shots all around the ground and Kohli also played his part perfectly at the other end. They put up a partnership of 104 from just 62 balls and by the time SKY departed India were in the driver’s seat. Things got quite close in the end though with Australia bowling well in the death but Pandya kept his cool after Kohli's dismissal and took India over the line.

India have clinched the series with a win here in this cracker of a game! The momentum kept swinging from one team to another throughout this match but it is India who have come out on top in the end. It is a kind of series and the competition these two teams would have desired for ahead of the World Cup and have to say, it has been a thoroughly entertaining series with the quality of cricket being of the highest order.

FOUR! Hardik Pandya has done it! Daniel Sams bowls a yorker length delivery, on off, Hardik Pandya throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge past the diving Cameron Green at short third man as the ball races away for a boundary at the third man fence. India win by 6 wickets and take the series 2-1.
A dot! This is full and outside off, Hardik Pandya is standing slightly across and tries to go for the slog but misses. It is not called a wide. 4 runs needed in 2 balls. Pressure on Pandya now.
Just a single! Sams comes 'round the wicket and bowls it on a length and outside off. Dinesh Karthik slams it uppishly but well short of long off for a single.
Dinesh Karthik walks out to the middle now! Can he repeat the heroics of the last game? 5 needed now from 4 balls!

OUT! TAKEN! Virat Kohli has to go back now as he tries to finish things off. This is full and around off, Virat Kohli tries to go over extra cover, but cannot get the elevation and hits it straight to Aaron Finch who makes no mistake. Virat Kohli has played a fine knock here but is there still a twist in the tale?
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Daniel Sams

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! This is just what India needed! Daniel Sams bowls a slower one, full and on middle, in the slot, Virat Kohli waits for it and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie. 5 runs needed in 5 balls now.
Who will bowl the last over? It will be Daniel Sams! Here we go...
A full toss and on middle, Virat Kohli heaves it towards deep square leg for just a single. 11 runs needed in the last over!
Full and around off, Virat Kohli drives it wide of deep point where Glenn Maxwell covers his ground and dives to his right to save a crucial boundary. Only two runs taken.
Swing and a miss! This is another brilliant yorker, on off, Virat Kohli swings but cannot connect. Two dots in a row now!
A dot! This is on good length and around off, Virat Kohli leaves it thinking that it is a wide. The umpire says it is a legal delivery.
A good yorker now, on off, Hardik Pandya digs it towards long off for a single.
SIX! A huge shot under pressure! Josh Hazlewood bowls a low full toss, outiside off, Hardik Pandya moves across and smokes it just over the long on fielder for a biggie.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl the 19th over! This is a huge over in the context of the game!
Full and on off, Virat Kohli drives it uppishly towards deep point for a couple of runs. 21 runs needed in 12 balls now. We are in for another thrilling finish here.
Another yorker, outside off, Hardik Pandya tries to squeeze it but hits it straight to point.

TWO WIDES! A slower bouncer now, on middle, this is way above the height of the batter, Virat Kohli tries to play at it but misses and Wade cannot collect it cleanly as it goes towards short fine leg. A bye is taken and it is called a wide for height.

Overthrows! A full toss and on off, Hardik Pandya slashes at it but it goes off the outside edge towards short third man, the fielder there has a shy at the batter's end but misses. The ball goes towards mid-wicket and a single is taken in the end.
Nails the yorker this time, outside off, Hardik Pandya goes for the same shot but gets beaten.

FOUR! A streaky boundary but India will take it. Pat Cummins bowls this almost on a yorker length and outside off, Hardik Pandya puts his bat down and the ball goes off the outer half towards the vacant third man fence for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Virat Kohli tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length and on off, Hardik Pandya drags his pull shot wide of deep mid-wicket where Pat Cummins runs and dives to his left to keep it in. Two runs taken. 32 needed in 18 now.
On a length and around off, slower too, Hardik Pandya goes for the cut but gets beaten due to the lack of pace.
WIDE! This is full and outside off, way outside off Hardik Pandya tries to reach for it but misses. Wided.
Full and on middle, Virat Kohli drills it down to long on for a run.

DROPPED! Another tough chance but it goes away. Sams bowls this slower, full and on off, Virat Kohli slogs it uppishly back towards the bowler where Daniel Sams can only get a hand to it but fails to grab it. A dot!
Short of a length and outside off, Hardik Pandya slaps it towards sweeper cover for a run.
A slower one, on a length and on off, Hardik Pandya stays there and crunches it wide of long on where Steven Smith covers his ground well, dives to his left and stops it. Two runs taken!
Green lands in another short ball, on off, Virat Kohli goes for the pull shot again but misses.
Daniel Sams is back on. Two overs for 15 runs and a wicket so far!
WIDE! This is on a length and way down the leg side, Kohli tries to play at it but misses. Wided.
Short again and on middle, Hardik Pandya pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

FIFTY FOR KOHLI! This is his 33rd half century in T20Is and it has come in a crucial time for India. Coming to the delivery, it is short and on middle, Virat Kohli pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Can he take his side over the line now?
Green bangs in a short ball, off, Hardik Pandya gets hurried and mistimes his pull shot towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a run.
Full again and on middle, Virat Kohli tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and around off, Virat Kohli makes room to play at it but goes too far away from the ball and cannot connect.
Cameron Green is back on. Two overs for 9 runs so far.
Touch shorter and outside off. Kohli punches it to deep point for a single. Just 44 needed now from 30 balls!
Another short delivery on off. This time Pandya pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Pandya is hurried by this short delivery but manages to defend it towards the off side.
Full and on the pads. Kohli clips it to deep backward square leg for a single.

SIX! Now, Kohli gets into the act! What a shot! An overpitched delivery on off. Kohli does not try to hit it hard and just time this lofted drive brilliantly as he hits it over the long off fielder for a maximum.
Back of a length, around off. Kohli dabs it towards backward point.
Hardik Pandya is the next man in for India. Also, Pat Cummins (2-0-20-1) comes back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, a wicket against the run of play here! Suryakumar Yadav departs and Australia finally get a breakthrough! Much-needed for Australia and now 53 more needed from 36 balls! This is a full delivery on off. Suryakumar Yadav makes room and tries to hit it towards the extra-cover region. However, he ends up hitting it a bit straighter and it goes straight into the hands of Aaron Finch at long off. He makes no mistake and Suryakumar Yadav stands there in disbelief. He has a smile on his face but has to walk back here.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Josh bowls it full and around off. Kohli drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
This is a full delivery on off. Yadav drills it to long off for a single.
SIX! Catch this, if you can! Suryakumar Yadav is playing a fantastic knock here! A fullish delivery on off. Suryakumar Yadav gets across to his right and heaves it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Short and outside off. Yadav makes room and tries to cut it but misses.

FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav continues to find boundaries! He is toying with the field now. A short delivery on middle. Yadav knows that mid on is inside the circle and he slams it over that fielder for a boundary.
Josh Hazlewood (2-0-18-0) is back on.
A fuller delivery on leg this time. Yadav whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 65 needed now from 42 balls!

SIX! This is guy is some player! Plays all around the ground with such ease and finesse! This one is fuller on off. Yadav makes room and plays a delightful inside-out lofted drive over extra-cover for a maximum.

SIX! Wow! What a way to get to your fifty! This is some amazing hitting! Tossed up on leg. Suryakumar Yadav skips down the track, converts it into a full toss and whips it over wide long on for a maximum.
Dot now! Pitches it on middle and it tuns in. Yadav does not pick the googly and tries to clip it but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
On the shorter side, on off. Kohli rocks back and tries to pull it. He, however, gets an inside edge that goes towards short fine leg and a single is taken.
Tossed up delivery on leg. Yadav makes room and steers it to deep point for a single.
Adam Zampa to bowl out now. He has conceded 29 runs in his three overs.
Back of a length and outside off. Yadav punches it off the outside half of his blade aerially towards deep backward point for a single. India now need 80 runs from 48 balls!

In the air...but safe! This is a good short ball from Green, hurries Kohli. He tries to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air towards square leg and it falls in the no man's land. A single taken.
Back of a length, around off. Yadav guides it to third man for a single.
Bangs it short and around leg. Suryakumar Yadav gets bit across to his right and tries to pull it but misses.
Oh, beaten! Hits the hard length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav stays deep in his crease and tries to smash it away but only connects with thin air.
Back of a length, on off. Kohli makes room and guides it to third man for a single.
SIX! This has been a gem of a knock from SKY! It is short and on off. Suryakumar Yadav picks the length quickly, hangs on the back foot and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Back of a length, on off. Yadav punches it bit uppishly towards covers for a couple.
Dot ball, very good change of pace! A slower short ball, outside off. Yadav is through with his pull shot early and misses it completely.
Back of a length, on off. Kohli dabs it behind square on the off side for a single.
Tad shorter and outside off. Yadav punches it towards deep point for just a single.
Lands on a length, on middle. Yadav clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.

Drinks break. India have done pretty well to keep the scoring going at a brisk rate despite losing two wickets in the Powerplay. Both Virat Kohli and Suryakumar Yadav are looking quite good and are well settled to take the game on from hereon. India need now 96 runs from last 10 and Australia need to get some wickets quickly otherwise this game can drift away from them quickly. Also, Pat Cummins to bowl after the break.
Short of a length and outisde off, Virat Kohli reaches for it and slaps it towards extra covers.
A dipping full toss, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav looks to sweep it but hits it from the toe end towards mid on. A single is taken as Sams runs and fields it.
SIX! What a shot! Daniel Sams bowls this a but fuller and on off, Suryakumar Yadav makes room and lofts it over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
Length again and on leg, Virat Kohli tucks it towards mid-wicket for one more.
A slower one now, on a length and on leg, Suryakumar Yadav chips it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length and around off, Virat Kohli guides it towards short third man for a single.
India are doing well to keep up with the required run-rate here.
Tossed up, full and on off, Suryakumar Yadav uses his feet and drills it wide of long off for a brace.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished. Zampa lands this short and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav stays there and cuts it past point for a boundnary.
Quicker, full and on middle, Virat Kohli tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Nice use of the feet here from Kohli. Adam Zampa flights this one up, full and on middle, Virat Kohli skips down the track and launches it over the long off fence for a biggie.
A bit short and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav looks to cut it but bunts it onto the ground and towards short third man. The batters get across for a quick single.
Floated, full and on leg, Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Adam Zampa will continue.
Shorter in length again, on leg, Suryakumar Yadav eases it towards long on for a run.
Quicker one, short and on leg, Virat Kohli looks to push it away but gets beaten and Wade parries it towards short fine leg. A bye is taken.
Short and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav flicks it off his back foot through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Another one for Yadav! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav goes down and slog-sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is short and around off, Suryakumar Yadav makes room and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
Glenn Maxwell starts with a yorker length delivery, on leg, Virat Kohli digs it towards long on for a single.
Full again and on middle, Virat Kohli works it towards long on for a run.
Looped up, full and on off, Suryakumar Yadav mistimes his drive towards long off for one.

DROPPED! A very tough chance though. This is floated, full and on middle, Virat Kohli uses his feet and smashes it back towards the bowler in the air where Adam Zampa gets a hand to it but cannot grab it as it was hit with power. A single taken.
Short again and around off, Suryakumar Yadav moves back and punches it towards deep point for a run.
A bit short and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav cuts it but straight to point.
Tossed up, full and on off, Virat Kohli leans on and knocks it towards covers for a quick single.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack. His first over went for 10 runs!
Goes fuller and on middle, Virat Kohli pushes it towards covers for a single. With that, the 50 comes up for India. They are 50 for 2 after the end of the Powerplay.
This is on a good length and around off, Virat Kohli tries to go for the drive on the up but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is fuller and outside off, Virat Kohli stays in his crease and lofts it over extra covers for a lovely boundary.
SIX! BANG! Josh Hazlewood serves this one on a good length as well, on middle, Virat Kohli stays there and heave it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On a length and on leg, Virat Kohli looks to work it away to the leg side but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and on off, Virat Kohli swings across the line but cannot connect.
A fullish delivery on off. Suryakumar Yadav drives it straight to mid off.
Serves it on a length, on mdidle. Kohli clips it to fine leg for a single.
Hits the hard length this time, on off. Kohli defends it from his crease.
This is full and outside off. Kohli tries to do something different by backing away but ends up failing to get a bat on the ball.
Ohh...what a comeback by Green! Lands it on a good length, on off. The ball seams away just a bit after pitching and beats the outside edge of Kohli's blade as he tries to defend it.
FOUR! Classical shot from a classy player! A fullish delivery, around off. Kohli leans forward and creams it through cover-point for a boundary.
Cameron Green has been introduced into the attack.
FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav is off the mark in style! Cummins keeps it short and outside off. This time Suryakumar Yadav gets on the top of the ball and cuts it over covers for a boundary.
Back of a length and outside off. The ball pitches and seams away as Yadav is beaten while trying to push it away.
Suryakumar Yadav comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rohit Sharma holes out in the deep! This is a big blow to India and Pat Cummins is delighted. Big, big wicket for Australia! Cummins bowls it short and on off. Rohit Sharma dances down the track and tries to slap it over the mid-wicket fence. However, he does not find the middle of his blade and ends up hitting it straight down the throat of Daniel Sams at deep mid-wicket. He takes it cleanly and India are in a spot of bother here.
Commentary.Howout: c Daniel Sams b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on off. Sharma tries to pull it but gets hit high on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.
A cutter this time! A length delivery on off. Sharma defends it from his crease.

FOUR! Cummins finds the top edge and the ball goes away towards the fine leg fence. This is short and around leg. Sharma tries to pull it. However, he gets a top edge that goes over the short fine leg fielder and almost travels the distace. One bounce and into the fence.
Pat Cummins comes into the attack now.
Serves it fuller on middle. Rohit Sharma clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 10 from the over!
Bowls it quicker on middle. Rohit Sharma defends it towards the leg side.

FOUR! Moral victory for the bowler but it is four crucial runs for India! This is tossed up, on off. Sharma tries to drive it. However, the ball turns and catches the outisde edge of his blade which runs away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Pushes it quicker on off. Sharma blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle. Kohli knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! An overpitched delivery on off. Kohli makes some room and plays a delightful cover drive in the gap for a boundary.
SIX! This time he stays still and smashes it over the fence! Josh Hazlewood continues to hit the hard lengths on off. Sharma stands tall and deposits it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length and outside off. Sharma gets across to his right and tries to scoop it but misses.
On a length and outside off. Sharma pushes it to the point fielder.
FOUR LEG BYES! On a length and down the leg side. Sharma tries to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and runs towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Virat Kohli dabs it towards point for a single.
On a good length and outside off. Virat Kohli leaves it alone. Some movement there for Josh Hazlewood.
Virat Kohli walks out to bat at number 3. Also, Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Daniel Sams strikes in his first over and it is a big one of KL Rahul! That's a poor shot from Rahul. Sams keeps it on the shorter side, around off. The natural angles takes it across Rahul and he goes for the pull shot. The ball catches the top edge and goes in the air behind the keeper. It goes very high indeed and Wade keeps his eye on the ball till the last moment and moves backwards and towards his left to take a very good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Daniel Sams

Commentary.Commentary: A slower short ball on middle. Sharma is way early in his pull shot and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
A single and Rahul is off the mark now! Serves it on a length, on off. Rahul dabs it with soft hands and takes a single as the ball rolls towards the off side.
Serves it on a length, on off. Rahul blocks it out.
On a length, on middle. Rohit Sharma clips it to deep square leg for a single. He is off the mark.

TWO WIDES! Good effort by Wade there! Sams bangs it short but way down the leg side. Rahul lets it go and Wade puts up a full-length dive to his left. He gets a glove on it and a bye is taken towards the fine leg region.
Sams starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery that is angled into Rahul from 'round the wicket. Rahul manages to defends it somehow onto the pitch.
